billName: Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam (106th Constitutional Amendment)
summary: Reserves 33% of seats in Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies for women, ensuring direct political decision-making power for female leaders.
whatItAchieves: Ensures at least 181 female MPs in Parliament and empowers women in policy drafting across every state.

summary: Establishes a comprehensive legal framework for digital privacy, consent architecture, data fiduciary obligations, and heavy penalties for unauthorized data breaches.
whatItAchieves: Protects citizen digital privacy while creating trust in digital public infrastructure and tech businesses.

billName: Energy Conservation (Amendment) Act & Green Hydrogen Mission
summary: Mandates clean energy consumption norms for heavy industries, introduces Carbon Credit Trading Markets, and promotes green hydrogen substitution.
whatItAchieves: Accelerates industrial decarbonization and positions India as a exporter of Green Hydrogen.

summary: Replaces 138-year-old colonial telegraph laws with a modern, spectrum-allocation and cybersecurity framework for 5G/6G networks and satellite internet.
whatItAchieves: Simplifies telecom infrastructure rollout and expands fast internet to remote border villages.

billName: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) & Criminal Law Reforms
summary: Replaces colonial Indian Penal Code (1860) with citizen-centric laws prioritizing justice over punishment, digital evidence, and mandatory forensic investigation.
whatItAchieves: Speeds up trial timelines, introduces community service for minor offenses, and digitizes trial proceedings.

summary: Allocates ₹50,000 Crore over 5 years to seed, grow, and promote high-impact scientific research and university labs across India.
whatItAchieves: Bridges academic research with industry innovation to build homegrown patents and deeptech breakthroughs.
